scientific.integrity: The printed discrete PID recurrences are eliminated algebraically on a constant SPD Hessian. The resulting modal polynomial is checked by the strict Jury criterion, giving necessary and sufficient conditions rather than a sufficient bound.
limitations: Deterministic SPD quadratics with constant Hessian.
Source range \(0<\alpha<1\) and nonnegative derivative gain.
Exact asymptotic stability of the discrete recurrence, not a stochastic deep-network convergence theorem.
The result does not equate transient overshoot with asymptotic spectral radius.

title: The discrete PID optimizer is curvature-dependent heavy ball on quadratics
